image_prompt_en: Landscape, high-resolution, cinematic wide-angle view of a modern stadium at dusk during a match, showing a convergence of sport, media and entertainment: semi-transparent AR data overlays (heatmaps on the pitch, real-time event markers, attendance forecasting graphs) floating above the field; robotic camera rigs and visible sensors on floodlights; staff with tablets receiving automated alerts at concourses; fans in seats looking at smartphones showing personalised highlight clips and dynamic ticket offers. Include a digital billboard in the scene subtly labeled 'Deloitte 2026 Outlook'. Colour palette of deep blues and neon accents, realistic photographic style, clear focus on technology integrating operations and fan experience, landscape orientation.
